name: smoke
description: Small, fully checkable coding tasks. The offline simulator fails these on purpose: they measure real models.

tasks.name: fizzbuzz
tasks.title: Write fizzbuzz.py with a function fizzbuzz(n) returning 'Fizz', 'Buzz', 'FizzBuzz' or str(n)
tasks.description: Create fizzbuzz.py at the repository root. fizzbuzz(3) == 'Fizz', fizzbuzz(5) == 'Buzz', fizzbuzz(15) == 'FizzBuzz', fizzbuzz(7) == '7'. Add tests in tests/test_fizzbuzz.py.
checks: python3 -c "from fizzbuzz import fizzbuzz as f; assert [f(i) for i in (3, 5, 15, 7)] == ['Fizz', 'Buzz', 'FizzBuzz', '7']"

tasks.name: fix-average
tasks.title: Fix the average() bug in stats.py
tasks.description: average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError; it must return 0.0. average([1, 2]) must stay 1.5. Change only stats.py.
checks: python3 -c "from stats import average as a; assert a([]) == 0.0 and a([1, 2]) == 1.5"

tasks.name: slugify
tasks.title: Add slugify(text) to text_utils.py
tasks.description: slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'; runs of non-alphanumerics become one dash; no leading or trailing dash.
checks: python3 -c "from text_utils import slugify as s; assert s('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world' and s('  a--b  ') == 'a-b'"
